kit_page.name: light_rim_kit
kit_page.summary: Rig rim light: a grazing-angle edge on the subject from the rig's own lights, with rim quality, tron tint and light wrap.

kit_row.help: Overall rim strength; multiplies each light's amount below. 0 matches Enable off.
kit_row.keywords: gain strength Golden Hour Flare Glacial Frost Edge Strobe Cut Aquatic Caustic Rim Ember Lick Overcast Diffusion Clamshell Beauty Edge Limelight Beam Crypt Pale Glow Rain Slick Glaze Dusk Horizon Kick Spectral Silhouette Natural Separation Dialogue Two-Shot Interview Hair Light Window Backlight Overcast Outdoor Night Street Edge Lamp Practical Dark Background Lift
kit_row.label: Master

slider.name: cine_rig_rim_master_gain
slider.tool_tip: Overall rim strength. Multiplies every fixture's own amount below; zero matches Enable off.

kit_row.help: How much rough surfaces get a wider, softer rim band.
kit_row.label: Soften

slider.name: cine_rig_rim_roughness_soften
slider.tool_tip: Rough surfaces get a wider, softer rim band.

kit_row.help: How gradually a light counts as behind the subject. Higher is a softer ramp.
kit_row.label: Back softness

slider.name: cine_rig_rim_back_softness
slider.tool_tip: Softness of the back-light ramp: how gradually a light counts as 'behind' the subject.

kit_row.help: 0 is the light's own colour; 1 multiplies the rim by the surface colour.
kit_row.label: Tint

slider.name: cine_rig_rim_tint
slider.tool_tip: 0 = pure light colour, 1 = rim takes the surface colour.

kit_row.help: How much a light's shadow darkens its rim. 1 is physical; lower rims lights directly behind but lets rim show through occluders.
kit_row.label: Shadow

slider.name: cine_rig_rim_shadow
slider.tool_tip: How much the light's shadow darkens its rim. 1 = shadowed exactly like the light (default). Lower it if a light directly behind the subject gives little or no rim. Caution: low values also let the rim show through walls or people standing in front of the subject.

kit_row.help: Rim on transparent and alpha surfaces such as hair.
kit_row.label: Alpha surfaces

kit_switch.name: cine_rig_rim_include_alpha
kit_switch.tool_tip: Rim on transparent / alpha-blended surfaces such as hair.

kit_row.help: Also render the rim into reflection-probe captures.
kit_row.label: Probes

kit_switch.name: cine_rig_rim_include_probes
kit_switch.tool_tip: Also render rim into reflection-probe captures.

kit_row.help: Lets the rig's synthetic bounce fills carry their light's rim.
kit_row.label: Bounce fills

kit_switch.name: cine_rig_rim_include_bounce
kit_switch.tool_tip: The rig's synthetic bounce fills carry their light's rim.

kit_row.help: Blends toward surface-aware smooth normals to remove facets and blocky edges. 0 keeps the original rim.
kit_row.keywords: smooth normals texture normals facets blocky normal sparkle
kit_row.label: Smoothness

kit_row.help: Surface radius in centimetres. Follows distance, zoom and resolution. Used when Smoothness is above 0.
kit_row.keywords: smooth normals facets blocky radius cm
kit_row.label: Smooth radius

kit_row.help: Normal-map detail on the smooth base: 0 is pure smooth, 1 restores texture detail while suppressing triangle facets. Used when Smoothness is above 0.
kit_row.keywords: texture normals smooth normals normal maps facets blocky
kit_row.label: Texture normals

kit_row.help: Reduces shimmer of the rim on fine specular detail as things move. 0 to 1.
kit_row.label: Steady

kit_row.help: Limits the rim to avatars and Actor Mask; it falls back to world-wide if there are none.
kit_row.label: Actors only

kit_row.help: Turns on the avatar tag that Actors only needs. Shows only when the rim status reports it missing.
kit_row.label: Avatar tag

kit_row.help: Whether rim quality features are running, and what is missing.

kit_row.help: How tightly the rim is confined to the silhouette band. 0 is off.
kit_row.label: Edge

kit_row.help: Thickness of the edge at the subject, in cm or pixels as set by Units.

kit_card.name: kc_light_shape
kit_card.enable_tooltip: Give local lights a size for softer highlights and light that wraps around forms.
kit_card.title: Light shape

kit_row.help: Use natural distance falloff, matched to the existing brightness at the subject.
kit_row.keywords: relight physical inverse square falloff attenuation calibration
kit_row.label: Physical falloff

kit_row.help: Source radius in metres. The slider gives fine control over small lights; type an exact radius. Zero keeps a point source; Physical falloff is independent of size.
kit_row.keywords: relight sphere area source radius world prim light size
kit_row.label: World light size (m)

kit_row.help: Use half the emitting prim's smallest dimension, up to 1 m, while rig lights keep their own size. Overrides World light size for ordinary SL lights.
kit_row.keywords: relight prim size light size bulb size emitting source radius
kit_row.label: Size from prim

kit_row.help: Scale the source size for highlights only. Diffuse wrap and soft shadows keep the full size.
kit_row.keywords: relight specular highlight softness source size
kit_row.label: Highlight softness

kit_row.help: Apply source size and highlight softness together. Bulb: 3 cm; Practical: 12 cm; Softbox: 45 cm; Window: 90 cm.
kit_row.keywords: relight bulb practical softbox window size preset
kit_row.label: Size preset

kit_row.help: Minimum distance used for falloff to keep lights near a face under control.
kit_row.label: Near floor (m)

kit_row.help: Limit close-up brightness to this multiple of the old light peak.
kit_row.label: Max boost

kit_card.name: kc_area_soft_shadows
kit_card.enable_tooltip: Add soft shadows from visible opaque blockers. VCam feeds have a separate opt-in; alpha hair and mirrors keep their current lighting.
kit_card.title: Soft shadows

kit_row.help: Catch railings, fences and poles. Each light costs more work, so when the work budget cannot cover every light this way, the most important lights get the Thin march and the others keep the regular soft shadow (see Coverage). Turning this on never removes a soft shadow. Use fewer Shadowed lights or a lower resolution to give more lights the Thin march.
kit_row.label: Thin objects

kit_row.help: The most important light (point or projector) gets a 3D shadow map: blockers anywhere around it cast, even off-screen, and the shadow stays put while you cam. Six shadow passes per light. Switch off and on to choose the light again.
kit_row.keywords: world shadow cube 3d off-screen behind camera stable orbit railing point omni projector spot
kit_row.label: World shadows

kit_row.help: How many lights (point or projector) get a world shadow map (1-2). Each costs six shadow passes and 6.8 MiB of video memory.
kit_row.keywords: world shadow cube lights count point omni world-shadow lights
kit_row.label: World lights

kit_row.help: Shows whether World shadows is on, and why it is not when it has no light to shadow: no point light in view, not enough video memory, or over the work budget at this size.
kit_row.keywords: world shadow cube status off choosing light memory budget
kit_row.label: World shadows

kit_row.help: The lights you ticked with World Shadow in the right-click menu, by object name. A pick whose object is not in the region stays in the list as (away) and takes its world shadow slot back when it returns. Picked lights get the world shadow slots first; the rest fill automatically.
kit_row.keywords: world shadow picks picked lights ticked away names right-click
kit_row.label: World picks

text.name: area_shadow_world_picks
text.tool_tip: Hover for the first picked lights; List picks prints every one to chat.

kit_row.help: Print every picked light to nearby chat (local only), one line per pick with (away) where the object is not in the region. The row above shows only the first few.
kit_row.keywords: world shadow picks list print chat names away
kit_row.label: List picks

kit_row.help: Clear manual world-shadow picks. Rig preferences are controlled by each fixture World shadow toggle.
kit_row.keywords: world shadow picks clear release untick reset
kit_row.label: Clear picks

kit_row.help: Release the picks whose light is not in the region now. A deleted light cannot be told from one that is only out of range, so this is up to you; picks whose light is here stay.
kit_row.keywords: world shadow picks clear away stale deleted release
kit_row.label: Clear away picks

kit_row.help: Trace soft shadows in VCam feeds using spare workload after the main view; feeds reduce quality or skip when that budget is full.
kit_row.keywords: vcam prism feed camera soft shadows budget
kit_row.label: Also in VCam feeds

kit_row.help: Shows reduced native shadow quality. Soft shadows remain independent of Preferences.
kit_row.keywords: relight soft shadows SL native preferences status off projector
kit_row.label: SL status
kit_row.text: SL shadows are off in Preferences; Soft shadows is off

kit_row.help: How many of the selected lights have a soft shadow, and how many of those have the Thin objects march. When the work budget cannot give every light a smooth shadow, the least important lights get none instead of a grainy one; with Thin objects on, the lights that cannot get the Thin march keep the regular soft shadow first. The quality preset does not change this. Choose fewer Shadowed lights, render at a lower resolution or raise Work budget to cover more.
kit_row.keywords: relight soft shadows coverage lights admitted budget status grain
kit_row.label: Coverage

kit_row.help: How dark the soft shadows get. 1 is the full shadow, 0.6 a lighter, filmic one, 0 no soft shadow (the work still runs at 0; switch Soft shadows off to save it). Applies to every soft-shadow light, world shadows included.
kit_row.keywords: strength power darkness opacity soft shadow lighter filmic
kit_row.label: Shadow strength

kit_row.help: Shapes the soft edge without changing the light size. Above 1 gives a harder, darker edge; below 1 a gentler one. 1 changes nothing.
kit_row.keywords: contrast hardness penumbra edge falloff soft shadow
kit_row.label: Shadow contrast

kit_row.help: Adds screen-space shading on top of world shadows (corners, vents). Higher = more of that look, but shadows from things off screen or behind the camera can come and go when the camera moves. 0 = off. Only lights that own a world shadow are affected.
kit_row.keywords: screen space detail corners vents ambient world shadow reach distance
kit_row.label: Screen-space detail (m)

kit_row.help: Mix control: how much of the stable world shadow you see. 1 is all of it, 0 none (the thin contact band stays). Lower it and raise Screen-space detail to lean toward the old screen-space look.
kit_row.keywords: mix blend world screen space vibe amount
kit_row.label: World shadow amount

kit_row.help: Mix control: how much of the screen-space detail you see. 1 is all of it, 0 none. The thin contact band next to a surface always stays.
kit_row.keywords: mix blend world screen space vibe amount
kit_row.label: Screen-space amount

kit_row.help: Choose up to eight lights. The most important lights (bright, large, close) get soft shadows.
kit_row.keywords: relight soft shadows local point projector occlusion contact hardening
kit_row.label: Shadowed lights

kit_row.help: Set ray count, march detail and resolution together. Cinematic costs more.
kit_row.keywords: relight soft shadows quality rays steps resolution workload
kit_row.label: Quality preset

kit_row.help: More rays smooth the soft edge at a higher rendering cost.
kit_row.label: Rays per light

kit_row.help: More depth checks find smaller blockers and cost more.
kit_row.label: March steps

kit_row.help: Stop looking for blockers after this distance from the surface.
kit_row.label: Trace distance (m)

kit_row.help: Finite depth tolerance for blockers. Large values can widen shadows. Use Light end bias to reduce lamp housing shadows.
kit_row.label: Thickness (m)

kit_row.help: Trace one quarter as many pixels, then keep edges sharp using depth and normals.
kit_row.label: Half resolution

kit_row.help: Soften noise using nearby surfaces. Spatial only. Zero skips the blur; any other value blurs at least 2 trace pixels, because the noise pattern needs that to disappear.
kit_row.label: Denoise radius

kit_row.help: Ignore the light housing near the source. Independent of blocker depth thickness. Raise it if a lamp, or a large glowing prim such as a lit room shell or big softbox, shadows itself; large values can miss nearby blockers.
kit_row.label: Light end bias (m)

kit_row.help: World shadows ignore geometry closer than this to the light. Raise it only if a lamp goes dark inside its own bulb.
kit_row.keywords: world shadow near clip floor lamp dark bulb cube plane
kit_row.label: Near clip (m)

kit_row.help: Close-contact shadow distance for projectors that have their own SL shadow map.
kit_row.keywords: projector contact distance sl native shadow map hit
kit_row.label: Contact (m)

kit_row.help: Show one selected light visibility channel in grayscale: white is lit, black is shadow. Channel numbers follow selected-light ranking; unavailable channels show the normal image.
kit_row.label: Visibility view

kit_row.help: Diagnostic for World shadows (World view): changes what the lights that own a cube write into their visibility, which you read with Visibility view above (pick that light). World only = the cube term alone. Face = grey level is the cube face (0..5 over 5). Depth difference = grey 0.5 is the surface the cube recorded, brighter means a blocker in front, black means nothing recorded. Off restores normal shadows.
kit_row.label: World view

kit_row.help: Maximum march work per frame in millions. When it runs short the march first loses resolution, then rays (never below 4) and steps, then the least important lights lose their soft shadow (see Coverage). Each draw uses at most half this budget.
kit_row.label: Work budget (M)

kit_row.help: Soft shadows use visible opaque depth. Alpha, probes, mirrors and tiled snapshots keep their existing shadows. VCam feeds require Also in VCam feeds; Light shape stays excluded there.
kit_row.keywords: relight second life native sun moon shadows preferences projector pcf pcss cookie graphics budget scene
kit_row.label: SL shadows
kit_row.text: Local opaque shadows work independently of Preferences shadow quality. Sun/moon shadows are unchanged. Projector shadow maps, when enabled, cover off-screen blockers. Quality and Work budget stay global when loading a scene.
